answer: Standing is a zephyr that only blows when a stranger explains why: each epoch’s work must be verified by an established peer who writes a short note explaining how they checked it — a glacier only moves when a stranger explains why it moved, and an island only counts when a stranger explains why it stands. A farm of a thousand fakes explains nothing: their verifiers never say how they checked, so their zephyrs never blow, and one epoch of unexplained work adds nothing.
